WITH country_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    p.birth_country, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.player_id) as player_count
  FROM player_college pc
  JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.birth_country IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.birth_country
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(player_count) as total_count,
    AVG(player_count) as avg_count
  FROM country_counts
),
with_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    cc.player_count,
    cc.player_count * 1.0 / (SELECT total_count FROM stats) as share,
    cc.player_count - (SELECT avg_count FROM stats) as excess
  FROM country_counts cc
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM with_shares
  WHERE player_count > (SELECT avg_count FROM stats)
)
SELECT 
  SUM(player_count) as total_player_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM above_average

assumptions.assumption: Players with NULL birth_country are excluded from analysis, as the request refers to 'each birth_country' and NULL is not a meaningful country value.
